# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities in MI Code as an issue or a pull request with the fix in
[this repository](https://github.com/MiCat-S/MiCode). MI Code has no private disclosure process;
confirmed fixes are merged directly.

MI Code is an unofficial fork of T3 Code. Report vulnerabilities in upstream T3 Code or T3
Tools-operated infrastructure as described in the [T3 Code security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).
